test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states has mangrove forests?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** is one of the states in India that has mangrove forests.
 
• Mangrove forests are coastal ecosystems found in tropical and subtropical regions, characterized by salt-tolerant trees and shrubs.
 
• These forests play a crucial role in protecting coastal areas from erosion, storm surges, and maintaining biodiversity.
 
• Andhra Pradesh has significant mangrove cover, particularly in the Godavari and Krishna delta regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options listed do not have mangrove forests. For instance, **Manipur** is a landlocked state, and **Telangana** and **Rajasthan** do not have coastal regions conducive for mangrove ecosystems.
 
• Mangroves are vital for the environment as they provide habitat for various species, support fisheries, and help in carbon sequestration.
 
• Conservation efforts are essential to protect these unique ecosystems from threats like deforestation, pollution, and climate change.
 
• In India, mangrove forests are also found in other states such as West Bengal (Sundarbans), Odisha, Tamil Nadu, and Gujarat.
